title: Degree of an affine Boolean function
statement: For $b\in\mathbb{F}_2$ and $a$ in the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$, the affine Boolean function $x\mapsto b+a\cdot x$ has algebraic degree at most $1$, where the dot product and addition are over $\mathbb{F}_2$.
